According to the comments in the code, the threshold was **narrowed from `<=5` to `<=2` tokens**.

The regression it fixed: short natural-language queries with 3–5 tokens (e.g., "how does auth work") were being routed to keyword-only L2 and never reaching semantic search. With the old `<=5` threshold, these queries stayed in pure L2 instead of falling through to L2_L3_HYBRID (which would have provided semantic recall via RRF fusion).

The comment states: "Keep this narrow — only true keyword/tag lookups (1-2 tokens) stay pure-L2."
